title: Construction of Tangents to a Circle — Constructions
hook: Let's explore Construction of Tangents to a Circle from the chapter on Constructions. This is an important concept in NCERT Class 10 Mathematics that builds your foundation for higher studies!
explanation:
Construction of Tangents to a Circle Construct tangents to a circle from a point outside it, and construct a tangent at a point on the circle. Uses the property that tangent ⊥ radius. Key Ideas to Master:
💡 Tangent from external point: find midpoint of OP, draw circle with that as centre
💡 Intersection points give points of tangency
💡 Tangent at a point on circle: draw radius, construct perpendicular
💡 Two tangents from external point are always equal
